title: Ariel School witnesses reunite in Los Angeles

tellings.quote: they all just agreed for the first time ever to get back together after 20 years of the case The Landing case in Ru Zimbabwe

plain: Former pupils of the Ariel School in Ruwa, Zimbabwe, who as children reported a craft landing near their school, agreed in 2013 to meet again for the first time, about twenty years after the event, in Los Angeles. The UFO investigator James Fox tells this first-hand, as the person who brought them together. He tells it to show the witnesses still stood by what they saw.
